newsitem.title: USA: Strategic Diagnostics Q4 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Strategic Diagnostics Q4 net loss widens.

text.p: Equity in income of TSD Bioservices 178 41

The company also reported pro forma results for 1996 that include data from the former Strategic Diagnostics Inc which merged with EnSys Environmental Products Inc ENSY.O to form the new Strategic Diagnostics Inc in December 1996, EnSys Environmental, Ohmicron Corp which was acquired by the former Strategic Diagnostics in August 1996, EnviroGard which was acquired by EnSys Environmental from Millipore Corp in March 1996 and TSD BioServices which was converted from a joint venture with the former Strategic Diagnostics into a wholly-owned subsidiary in October 1996.

Pro forma operating loss for fiscal 1996 was $4,908,000, or a loss of $0.39 per share, on $12,700,000 in revenues. Pro forma operating loss did not include merger-related and Millipore product line charges for acquired R&D of $9,966,000.
The company did not report comparable pro forma figures for fiscal 1995.
Shares used in computing loss per share
($ in 000s, except share data and per share data)
NOTE: Strategic Diagnostics Inc said its net loss for 1996 included a $8,266,000, or $1.95 per share, for merger-related charges from the Strategic Diagnostics, EnSys Environmental merger.
